title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. With 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V may be used in a charging circuit for a lithium ion battery. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a aluminum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 6.3 V.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an artificial interphase formed on a lithium metal negative electrode by thermal evaporation. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. An all-solid-state battery using a lithium metal anode together with the solid electrolyte shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 150 cycles or more and the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The inorganic layer suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments, while the polymer layer absorbs the cracks caused by volume change of the negative electrode. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The Li3PS4 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The solid electrolyte is preferably beta-Li3PS4. The suppression of filament penetration results in a longer cycle life and improved dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 5 nm to 300 nm, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.2 micrometers to 20 micrometers.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A glassy sulfide ion-conductive solid with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 70:30, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase precipitates uniformly. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 8 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 30% to 65% by X-ray diffraction. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The GeS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the carbon nanotubes suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the molybdenum disulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The active material is coated with a thin lithium phosphosulfide ion conductor layer so that the cathode can be used in a solid-state cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing molybdenum disulfide with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the molybdenum disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 40 cm3/g or less. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. An H2S generation of 40 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 75% or more are obtained. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the ionic conductivity and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 24 hours is 75% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a tin substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, vinylene carbonate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described. With 0.5 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition
abstract: Described is an oxide ceramic ion conductor whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. With hafnium substitution of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. The ion-conductive component may be lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the hafnium substitution and the surface region. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The Li2ZrO3 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The material is useful as a catholyte in a high-voltage positive electrode mixture, with improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising nickel sulfide and graphene and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises nickel sulfide impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the nickel sulfide cathode. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A lithium-sulfur battery with the nickel sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, graphene, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Ion-conductive solid sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: Described is a solvent-free film of an ion-conductive solid with a fibril network that gives a tensile strength of 1.2 MPa or more. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. With a binder content of 2 wt% and a roll temperature of 100 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 30% or less. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The disclosure is applicable to Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers. The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles. The sheet can be laminated onto an electrode without a drying step and improves the cycle life of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the thickness of the sheet is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 30% or less.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 4 stacked cells. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium niobate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous LiNbO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 80%. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The coating layer has an average thickness of 5 nm and a coverage of 80%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 30% relative to uncoated particles. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li3InCl6. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.5 nm to 25 nm.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The disclosure is applicable to Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The LGPS and Li3PS4 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.25 <= x <= 1.05, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet comprises ceramic ion conductor particles and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network that binds the particles without a solvent. After ball milling, the ceramic ion conductor precursor is pressed and sintered. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The powder used for the sheet is prepared by a wet-chemical synthesis with filtration and drying, and the moisture exposure is controlled by a dew point of -40 degrees C. The LATP and Li3PS4 material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The binder content is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, which gives a tensile strength of 2 MPa and a conductivity of 3 mS/cm. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The low porosity results in a low areal resistance and improved sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 30% or less, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing silica nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Zirconium-substituted Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO ion-conductive solid stable above 5 V and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an ion-conductive solid whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The anodic decomposition product layer after 100 cycles is 10 nm or less and the capacity retention is 90%. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved ionic conductivity at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.7 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium difluorophosphate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The capacity retention of 90% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Bromine-substituted Li6PS5X ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the Li6PS5X type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. The raw materials of the ceramic ion conductor are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The ceramic ion conductor exhibits an ionic conductivity of 6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the Li6PS5X crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. The Li6PS5Cl and LiNbO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The ceramic ion conductor provides improved high-voltage stability compared with a single-halogen Li6PS5X of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and to a lithium secondary battery comprising the same. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. In an embodiment the material is Li3InCl6, lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Firing is performed at 520 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3InCl6, LiNbO3, and Li2ZrO3 material. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The roll pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solvent-free free-standing solid electrolyte sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder and method for preparing the same
abstract: Described is a solvent-free film of a solid electrolyte with a fibril network that gives a tensile strength of 1.8 MPa or more. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and the sheet shows a conductivity of 2 mS/cm. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. The method shortens the process and improves the cycle life and interfacial resistance of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.9 MPa or more, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.05 wt% to 2.5 wt%.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector of nickel-plated copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 200 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Potentiometric ammonia sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The sensor operating at 700 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for ammonia. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of ammonia concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting ammonia, comprising: a ceramic body comprising sodium beta-alumina; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing silica nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Tin-substituted perovskite-type LLTO ion-conductive solid stable above 5 V and method for producing the same
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid that remains stable up to 5 V and a lithium battery with a high-voltage cathode are provided. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. Suitable compositions include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 5 V. The low electronic conductivity of the Li6PS5Cl material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the moisture stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 65% or more.

title: Halogen-rich Li6PS5X solid electrolyte having anion disorder and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide solid electrolyte having a cubic Li6PS5X structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. A precursor of the Li2ZrO3, Li6PS5Cl, and LiF material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and lithium fluoride (LiF), wherein the Li6PS5X crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, bromine, and iodine. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the bromine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The ion-conductive component may be lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and lithium fluoride (LiF). The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 5.1 mS/cm. Compared with Li6PS5Br, the iodine-substituted Li6PS5X shows a higher conductivity and better cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less.

title: Self-supporting solid electrolyte sheet having low porosity and method for calendering the same
abstract: A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet comprises solid electrolyte particles and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network that binds the particles without a solvent. The sheet is calendered to a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and laminated onto an electrode by roll-pressing without a drying step. The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. With a binder content of 1 wt% and a roll temperature of 80 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 16% or less. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite-type component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 80 degrees C to form a continuous film. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). An all-solid-state battery using the sheet shows improved grain boundary resistance and a thinner electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the free-standing solid electrolyte sheet has a roll temperature of 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 16% or less, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for nitrogen oxide with improved response time
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide comprises a lanthanum fluoride ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate makes the sensor selective to nitrogen oxide against interfering gases. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. A lithium carbonate auxiliary electrode may be used for detecting carbon dioxide at 400 degrees C. The sensor shows a response time of 5 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Method for producing an ion-conductive solid sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: Provided is a slurry in which ion-conductive solid particles are dispersed in heptane with a rubber binder and a dispersant. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The binder content is 5 wt%, the drying temperature is 100 degrees C, and the decrease in conductivity after slurry processing is 20% or less. The wet film is dried at 100 degrees C and the dried layer has a thickness of 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers. The raw materials of the ion-conductive solid are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the LATP material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The binder is a rubber that keeps the layer flexible after drying and does not block the ion conduction between particles. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The peeling from the release film gives a transferable sheet and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 80 degrees C to 120 degrees C.

title: Self-supporting ceramic ion conductor sheet having low porosity and method for calendering the same
abstract: Described is a solvent-free film of a ceramic ion conductor with a fibril network that gives a tensile strength of 1.2 MPa or more. The sheet is calendered to a thickness of 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers and laminated onto an electrode by roll-pressing without a drying step. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li3InCl6. The tensile strength is 1.2 MPa or more and the elongation at break is 5% or more. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved high-voltage stability. The low porosity results in a low areal resistance and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the thickness of the sheet is 5 micrometers to 150 micrometers, and wherein the free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet has a roll temperature of 20 degrees C to 160 degrees C, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.6 MPa or more.

title: Amperometric sulfur dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of sulfur dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. The sensor detects sulfur dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 300 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising lithium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects sulfur dioxide.

title: iron sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. Polysulfide dissolution from the iron sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 3 mg/cm2. The active material iron sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition for lithium battery
abstract: An oxide solid electrolyte stable against oxidation above 5.2 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 5.2 V. The positive electrode active material is LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide solid electrolyte. A Li6PS5X sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 87% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.9 V or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polycarbonate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polycarbonate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Silicon-substituted sulfide ion-conductive solid with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid silicon binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. After exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C for 24 hours, the conductivity retention is 70%. The ion-conductive solid may comprise argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. The powder is amorphized by mechanical milling in a dry room with a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower and then heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 100 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 24 hours is 45% or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 200 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 2 cells and a case is also provided. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet ion-conductive solid doped with gallium and sintered with LiF is described. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. Examples of the ion conductor include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). When v is 0.4, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm. The ion-conductive solid can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state battery. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 1 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein 0.21 <= v <= 0.9, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 89% or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium cobalt oxide, and a conductive agent. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using 1,2-dimethoxyethane
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 3 mS/cm. The suspension has a solid concentration of 7.5 wt% to 30 wt% and is reacted at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The method does not require long mechanical milling and gives a solid electrolyte with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. A mixed-halogen Li6PS5X phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 480 degrees C. When fired at 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 6.4 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. The material is useful as an ion-conductive solid layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.9 <= a <= 1.7, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

assignee: Hwaseol National Research Institute of Energy Materials
title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiTaO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose LiTaO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide ceramic ion conductor. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ceramic ion conductor in the all-solid-state battery. The coated particles are heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. Nickel accounts for 90 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 400 degrees C. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The Li6PS5Cl and Li2ZrO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 25% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.5 nm to 25 nm.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide.
