The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. The lithium tungstate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 15% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 70% or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ion-conductive solid using ethyl acetate and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The solvent is ethyl acetate, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A precursor of the LLZO, Li7P3S11, and LATP material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 5 mS/cm. A solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid obtained by the method shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 3.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated therein. Crystallization is performed at 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which precipitates a thio-LISICON phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. The precipitated thio-LISICON phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm. The material comprises Li7P3S11, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted Li6PS5X having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3PS4 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The disclosure is applicable to Li7P3S11, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. An all-solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved cycle life and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing the sulfide solid electrolyte of claim 1, the method comprising: melting or mechanically amorphizing a mixture of Li2S, P2S5, and Li2O to obtain a vitreous precursor; quenching the precursor to obtain a glass; and heat-treating the glass at 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 20 hours to precipitate the crystal phase.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a sulfide solid electrolyte that retains 75% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 2 cm3/g. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -20 degrees C and the exposure time is 1 hours. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved grain boundary resistance and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an oxygen substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours is 60% or more.

title: Composite cathode comprising molybdenum disulfide and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of molybdenum disulfide. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising ketjen black; molybdenum disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. After exposure to air with a dew point of -30 degrees C for 1 hours, the conductivity retention is 90%. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The powder is amorphized by mechanical milling in a dry room with a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower and then heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The ion-conductive solid retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 1 hours is 80% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a silicon substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer that has a solid content of 30 wt% to 50 wt% and a viscosity of 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The solvent has a donor number of 10 or less so that the ceramic ion conductor does not react with the solvent during slurry processing. The dried layer shows an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The binder is hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber in an amount of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt% and is dissolved in the nonpolar solvent heptane. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. Because the binder is dissolved in the solvent, the layer is uniform and shows improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the solid content of the slurry is 30 wt% to 50 wt%, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.8 mS/cm or more.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

assignee: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LDT.
title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. A lithium battery pack comprising 2 modules of the stacked cells is also described. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% with the electrolyte. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Potentiometric sulfur dioxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum fluoride conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The protective layer improves the durability of the lanthanum fluoride sensor in an exhaust gas.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting sulfur dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Lithium fluoride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium metal negative electrode having a protective layer with a thickness of 40 nm to 200 nm and a lithium metal battery including the same are provided. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 100 nm. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the solid-state battery. The disclosure is applicable to lithium fluoride (LiF), beta-Li3PS4, and Li3YCl6. The LiF layer of 100 nm lowers the interfacial resistance to 20 ohm cm2 or less. The material comprises lithium fluoride (LiF), beta-Li3PS4, and Li3YCl6, and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. The protective layer is useful for an anode-free cell, with improved dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 250 cycles or more, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.5% or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The cold isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl material. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. Partial substitution of chlorine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite phase is 0.1, and the room-temperature conductivity is 11.2 mS/cm. The ceramic ion conductor is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The mixed halogen substitution improves the cycle life and ionic conductivity of the all-solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed between the positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer, wherein the ceramic ion conductor layer is formed by the method of claim 1.

title: Mixed-halide solid electrolyte of yttrium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: A halide solid electrolyte comprises an orthorhombic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6. The halide phase is free of a LiBr secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. Suitable compositions include Li3InCl6. The hafnium substitution in an amount z of 0.2 to 0.45 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.47 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid tin binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. An H2S generation of 40 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 70% or more are obtained. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the moisture stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The capacity retention of 88% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium difluorophosphate. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ceramic ion conductor using a mother powder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor and to a lithium battery including the same. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. A lithium excess of 15 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The grain size is 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and the relative density is 93% or more after sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the grain boundary resistance and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a relative density of 93% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

title: Method for forming a ceramic ion conductor film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: This disclosure concerns a roll-pressing method for forming a ceramic ion conductor film without any solvent. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and the sheet shows a conductivity of 3 mS/cm. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The sheet can be laminated onto an electrode without a drying step and improves the moisture stability of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 30% or less.

title: Li6PS5X sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed chlorine-iodine substitution
abstract: Disclosed is a Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. Suitable compositions include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. A dry process in which the ion-conductive solid powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the lithium secondary battery. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl, LGPS, and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.1, and the room-temperature conductivity is 9.6 mS/cm. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The material is useful as an ion-conductive solid layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein 1.1 <= a <= 1.5, and wherein 0.15 <= y/a <= 0.45, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 7.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A glassy sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The ion-conductive component may be beta-Li3PS4, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 240 degrees C. The ceramic ion conductor powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 70%. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. An all-solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved cycle life and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 340 degrees C.

assignee: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: An argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and a method for producing the same are described. Firing is performed at 450 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 6 mS/cm. A solid-state battery comprising the LGPS, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.12 or less. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. A mixed-halogen argyrodite-type phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 450 degrees C. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the moisture stability of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65.

assignee: Corast Institute Of Technology INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC Cooperation Foundation
title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2WO4 shell with high coverage for lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium tungstate and to a method for producing the same. The coating layer has an average thickness of 8 nm and a coverage of 80%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 30% relative to uncoated particles. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. An all-solid-state battery using the coated active material shows improved high-voltage stability and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more.

title: iron sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode with a loading of 4 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Provided is a sulfide solid electrolyte that retains 80% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours. The solid electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 10 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C. The electrode mixture of the lithium secondary battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. The solid electrolyte is preferably argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the moisture stability are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours is 65% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Tin-substituted titanium-free NASICON-type oxide solid electrolyte stable above 5 V and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide solid electrolyte in which tin substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the tin substitution and the surface region. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 5 V. The solid electrolyte powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved sinterability at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.4 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ion-conductive solid using a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm or more. The solvent is a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 1 wt% or less, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: Described is a method of operating a solid-state lithium cell under a stack pressure of 5 MPa to 20 MPa with a zinc additive. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3YCl6 and Li3PS4 material. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li3YCl6 and beta-Li3PS4. A stack pressure of 5 MPa to 20 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the ceramic ion conductor is improved. The critical current density is 0.7 mA/cm2 or more and the number of cycles without short circuit is 500 cycles or more. The additive suppresses lithium dendrites and improves the ionic conductivity of the solid-state cell.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 98.2% or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the content of the zinc additive is 0.2 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant gallium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. When v is 0.2, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 0.6 mS/cm. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li2ZrO3, LLTO, and LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. The dopant gallium occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.05 to 0.4, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C, and wherein 0.05 <= v <= 0.4.

title: Dendrite-suppressing silver additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell and production method thereof
abstract: A negative electrode structure with a critical current density of 1.4 mA/cm2 or more and a method for suppressing void formation during stripping are provided. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the electronic conductivity of the ion-conductive solid layer is 1 x 10^-9 S/cm or less to prevent lithium deposition inside the layer. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The Li3InCl6 and Li2ZrO3 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The critical current density is 1.4 mA/cm2 or more and the number of cycles without short circuit is 500 cycles or more. A solid-state lithium cell using the structure shows improved interfacial resistance and operates at a lower stack pressure.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 500 cycles or more, and wherein the content of the silver additive is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: Described is a method of operating a solid-state lithium cell under a stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa with a lithium fluoride additive. A superionic argyrodite-type phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. The ion-conductive component may be lithium fluoride (LiF). Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The plating overpotential is 30 mV or less and the Coulombic efficiency is 99% after 100 cycles. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The method prevents short circuit and improves the interfacial resistance and cycle life without a thick protective layer.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the content of the lithium fluoride additive is 0.5 wt% to 25 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.5% or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder and method for producing the same
abstract: An argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and a method for producing the same are described. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiBr and Li3PS4. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The ceramic ion conductor exhibits an ionic conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ceramic ion conductor to improve the cycle life of the all-solid-state battery. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiBr relative to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.12 or less. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ceramic ion conductor in the all-solid-state battery. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The material is useful as a ceramic ion conductor layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved cycle life and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 8.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, ketjen black, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 2 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Amperometric carbon dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate makes the sensor selective to carbon dioxide against interfering gases. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: P2O5-containing vitreous sulfide solid electrolyte and heat treatment method
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated therein. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is Li7P3S11, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. Suitable compositions include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. The P2O5 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 20% to 100%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 190 degrees C to 380 degrees C.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiTaO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 90% or more and an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm is provided. The Li2ZrO3 and Li6PS5Cl material is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tantalate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The average thickness of the coating is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, the coverage is 90% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 90% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more.

title: thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Densified garnet oxide ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor and to a lithium battery including the same. A precursor of the LLTO and LATP material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The disclosure is applicable to Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The material comprises Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The grain size is 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and the relative density is 94% or more after sintering at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C. The low grain boundary resistance results in improved sinterability compared with a garnet sintered without the aid.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor of claim 1, the method comprising: calcining a mixture of Li2CO3, La2O3, ZrO2, and a gallium oxide with a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol% to obtain a mother powder; pressing the mother powder into a pellet; and sintering the pellet at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C while covering it with the mother powder to suppress lithium volatilization.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid silicon binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The solid electrolyte may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The low electronic conductivity of the Li6PS5Cl, LLZO, and Li3PS4 material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. Heat treatment at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C gives a conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm and a retention of 70% after humid exposure. The silicon substitution amount is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte of claim 1, the method comprising: mixing Li2S, P2S5, and a silicon source at a substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%; amorphizing the mixture by mechanical milling in a dry room having a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower; and heat-treating the amorphized mixture at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an argon atmosphere.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Tungsten-doped garnet solid electrolyte sintered body with high relative density and method for producing the same
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet solid electrolyte doped with tungsten and sintered with Li2CO3 is described. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. The solid electrolyte can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the solid-state battery. A sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The LATP, LLTO, and Li2ZrO3 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The grain size is 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and the relative density is 91% or more after sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C. The LATP, LLTO, and Li2ZrO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the high-voltage stability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 91% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

assignee: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which hydrolysis is suppressed by arsenic-free antimony substitution is provided. The arsenic-free antimony substitution amount is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 2.3 mS/cm. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. A lithium secondary battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. The disclosure is applicable to argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. The ceramic ion conductor retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved sinterability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours is 80% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: LiI-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 75:25 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ceramic ion conductor in the all-solid-state battery. The glass phase contains LiI in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the beta-Li3PS4 phase. The low electronic conductivity of the Li6PS5Cl material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ceramic ion conductor to improve the cycle life of the all-solid-state battery. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 50% to 85% by X-ray diffraction. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. The LiI addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
