The Li3PS4, LGPS, and Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The ceramic ion conductor shows improved electrochemical window compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 75%, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Iodine-substituted Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid for an all-solid-state battery has a Li6PS5X crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. An ionic conductivity of 3.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.4 to 0.85. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.25 <= x <= 1.05, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 360 degrees C to 610 degrees C.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the iron sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material iron sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The active material is coated with a thin lithium phosphosulfide ion conductor layer so that the cathode can be used in a solid-state cell. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing iron sulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the iron sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: SiS2-containing vitreous sulfide solid electrolyte and heat treatment method
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li7P3S11 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 50%. After heat treatment at 260 degrees C for 5 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 1.8 mS/cm. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), beta-Li3PS4, and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), beta-Li3PS4, and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The SiS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 40 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 170 degrees C to 360 degrees C, and wherein the content of SiS2 is 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which hydrolysis is suppressed by oxygen substitution is provided. The oxygen substitution amount is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 2.3 mS/cm. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The ceramic ion conductor powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The ceramic ion conductor retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an oxygen substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%.

assignee: Hwaseol National Research Institute Of Energy Materials
title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tantalate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and method for preparing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and nickel content of 70 mol% or more. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tantalate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.5 nm to 25 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 9.6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the lithium secondary battery. The ion-conductive solid provides improved moisture stability and ionic conductivity compared with a single-halogen argyrodite of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 7.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet comprises ceramic ion conductor particles and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network that binds the particles without a solvent. The sheet thickness is 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers, the porosity is 10% or less, and the conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm or more. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LATP and LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The low porosity results in a low areal resistance and improved interfacial resistance and sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the thickness of the sheet is 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.6 MPa or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The warm isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Dendrite-suppressing indium additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Provided is a solid-state cell in which indium is added at the lithium metal interface in an amount of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt% to suppress dendrites. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. With the additive in an amount of 2 wt% and a stack pressure of 10 MPa, the Coulombic efficiency is 99.5%. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. During stripping, the alloy phase of the additive keeps the contact and suppresses void growth. The additive suppresses lithium dendrites and improves the dendrite suppression and interfacial resistance of the solid-state cell.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 99% or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the content of the indium additive is 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and to a method of handling it in a dry room. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and LATP composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 4.5 mS/cm. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. After ball milling, the ion-conductive solid precursor is pressed and sintered. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The ion-conductive solid may comprise beta-Li3PS4, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). In a lithium secondary battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the grain boundary resistance. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -30 degrees C and the exposure time is 2 hours. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 2 hours is 75% or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. The solvent is ethyl propionate, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The ceramic ion conductor obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 1 wt%. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the reaction temperature is 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite-type family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. The disclosure is applicable to argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11 material. When fired at 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 7.2 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28 and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated therein. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 240 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 4 mS/cm. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is beta-Li3PS4, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 240 degrees C. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. The Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The solid electrolyte shows improved cycle life compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The 1.2 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The additive 1,3-propane sultone is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the ion-conductive solid is improved. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The oxygen substitution amount is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -30 degrees C and the exposure time is 24 hours. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved moisture stability and sinterability and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 25 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 24 hours is 45% or more.

title: Hafnium-substituted lithium erbium chloride ion-conductive solid with monoclinic structure for lithium battery
abstract: A halide ion-conductive solid comprises a monoclinic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3InCl6, Li2ZrO3, and LiF material. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The hafnium substitution in an amount z of 0.1 to 0.35 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. When z is 0.2, the conductivity is 3 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.2 V. The composition further comprises a lithium metal halide in which the chloride anion sublattice is close-packed, and the halide is synthesized together with the main phase. Specific examples are Li3InCl6, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and lithium fluoride (LiF). A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 420 degrees C.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The confinement of iron sulfide in the carbon nanotubes suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The iron sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by solution casting and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a protective layer comprising a Li3N inorganic layer and a fluorinated polymer for a lithium metal negative electrode. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4 material. The inorganic layer is formed by solution casting to a thickness of 200 nm to 1000 nm and has an ionic conductivity of 1 x 10^-6 S/cm or more at 25 degrees C. A cell with the protected lithium metal negative electrode operates for 200 cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2. The Li3PS4 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the cycle life and interfacial resistance of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 50 nm to 3000 nm, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.5% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.05 micrometers to 5 micrometers.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a thio-LISICON phase and method for preparing the same
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form an ion-conductive solid of high conductivity. The Li6PS5Cl, LGPS, and Li7P3S11 material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. The glass phase contains SiS2 in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the thio-LISICON phase. Crystallization is performed at 280 degrees C to 360 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 4 hours, which precipitates a thio-LISICON phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. In an embodiment the material is argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and Li7P3S11. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ion-conductive solid to improve the cycle life of the lithium secondary battery. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the cycle life of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of SiS2 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%.

title: Argyrodite sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite ion-conductive solid whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 9.6 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The ion-conductive solid can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state lithium battery. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.25 <= x <= 1.05.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A glassy sulfide solid electrolyte with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 8 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 40% to 75% by X-ray diffraction. The lithium secondary battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. The solid electrolyte is preferably argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 240 degrees C. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 20% to 100%.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet ion-conductive solid doped with niobium and sintered with Li3BO3 is described. The mother powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers, and the sintered body has a conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm. The LLZO material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 94% or more, and wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C.

title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic Al2O3 layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into an ion-conductive solid layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. A precursor of the Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5Cl material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 1 x 10^-6 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 99.5% after 100 cycles. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A lithium metal battery using the protective layer shows improved ionic conductivity and Coulombic efficiency.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising aluminum oxide deposited by atomic layer deposition (Al2O3) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.5% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 30 nm to 1800 nm, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.2 micrometers to 20 micrometers.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium borate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium borate and to a method for producing the same. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The average thickness of the coating is 2 nm to 10 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3YCl6 and LiF material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 90%. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material comprises Li3YCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the electrochemical window is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2WO4 shell with high coverage and lithium battery
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li2WO4 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Nickel accounts for 90 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 400 degrees C. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 80 mol% or more of the transition metals. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite-type having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 4 nm to 20 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and method for preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a ceramic ion conductor is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The Li3PS4, LATP, and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The coating speed is 5 m/min and the layer dried at 40 degrees C to 80 degrees C has a thickness of 15 micrometers. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. The slurry has a solid content of 40 wt% to 60 wt% and a viscosity of 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, which is suitable for doctor blade casting. A halogen-rich argyrodite-type with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The nonpolar solvent does not degrade the ceramic ion conductor, and the layer shows improved sheet formability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 2 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: An air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte in which hydrolysis is suppressed by arsenic-free antimony substitution is provided. A precursor of the Li7P3S11, Li3PS4, and LATP material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The powder is formed into a sheet by kneading with a fibrillated PTFE binder and roll-pressing without a solvent to a thickness of 30 micrometers to 80 micrometers. After exposure to air with a dew point of -30 degrees C for 1 hours, the conductivity retention is 80%. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%.

title: Solid electrolyte sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: Disclosed is a solvent-free method of forming a solid electrolyte sheet by kneading the powder with PTFE under shear and rolling the mixture between heated rollers. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl and LATP material. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The sheet has a thickness of 80 micrometers, a porosity of 5%, a tensile strength of 3 MPa, and an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers. Specific examples are argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The solvent-free sheet avoids the conductivity loss caused by polar solvents and improves the ionic conductivity and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the free-standing solid electrolyte sheet has a roll temperature of 20 degrees C to 160 degrees C, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.1 wt% to 5 wt%, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.9 MPa or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite ceramic ion conductor in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. Firing is performed at 520 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LGPS and Li6PS5Cl material. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The cold isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Lithium niobium tantalum oxide-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 50 mol% or more of the transition metals. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the ceramic ion conductor layer onto an electrode of the all-solid-state lithium battery without a drying step. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 15 nm. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 30 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant niobium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO material. A lithium excess of 8 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. Sintering at 1230 degrees C with a lithium excess of 8 mol% gives a relative density of 96% and a conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm. A sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 5 mol% to 13 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium metal layer, an ion-conductive solid layer, and an additive comprising magnesium dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. The additive particles have a size of 200 nm and the critical current density rises from 0.6 mA/cm2 to 1 mA/cm2. The cubic argyrodite-type structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium fluoride (LiF), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. Because nucleation is uniform, the local current density is reduced and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising magnesium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 150 cycles or more, and wherein the content of the magnesium additive is 2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and an oxygen-rich surface region is described. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 3.2 mS/cm. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. The LLZO material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C is 20 cm3/g. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The ion-conductive solid retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved sinterability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 24 hours is 65% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

assignee: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a Li7P3S11 phase for lithium battery
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28 and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated therein. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. Crystallization is performed at 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which precipitates a Li7P3S11 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. The GeS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 40 hours, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Li6PS5X sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-iodine substitution and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the Li6PS5X family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li7P3S11, Li3PS4, and LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Firing is performed at 480 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the electrochemical window of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 6.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less.

title: Method for forming a solid electrolyte film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers and a porosity of 16% or less is provided. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and the sheet shows a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 80 degrees C to form a continuous film. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved interfacial resistance. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. The sheet can be laminated onto an electrode without a drying step and improves the interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the free-standing solid electrolyte sheet has a roll temperature of 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 16% or less, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ion-conductive solid that does not require long mechanical milling. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the all-solid-state battery. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm or more. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1 wt% or less, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%.

title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. The ceramic ion conductor powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li7P3S11. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The oxygen substitution amount is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The substitution amount is 5 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 550 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.6 mS/cm or more. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The ceramic ion conductor retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours is 80% or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The cold isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 100 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The current collector of nickel-plated copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using 1,2-dimethoxyethane and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to give a sulfide solid electrolyte precursor. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO, Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11 material. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved sinterability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The stable passivation film formed by tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 1 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is also described. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with low residual solvent
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. The suspension has a solid concentration of 2.5 wt% to 10 wt% and is reacted at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The solid electrolyte can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the lithium secondary battery. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The Li6PS5Cl, LLZO, and Li3PS4 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. The reaction at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 3.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C.

title: Dendrite-suppressing indium additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell for lithium battery
abstract: Described is a method of operating a solid-state lithium cell under a stack pressure of 5 MPa to 20 MPa with an indium additive. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. Specific examples are Li3YCl6 and beta-Li3PS4.
